acceptanceCriteria: Use physical Go positions consistently for selected declaration and caller/reference anchors, irrespective of //line directives.
Validate ordered physical bounds and supplied source span before slicing; invalid provider anchors remain unresolved and are not traversed.
Retain internal red/green regressions for inner/before declaration/caller directives and reversed/oversize spans, fresh independent re-review, final integration and exact candidate evidence.
body: Confirmed in unreleased candidate27135d8bea35c02d0ee07270dd469ccaccb5784b by independent reviewer. FileSet.Position honors //line directives but read.go anchors slice physical blob lines. Repro package api + Changed function with inner //line fake.go:1 yields adjusted3..1 versus physical3..5; slice[2:1] panics. Before-function directive reports1..1 instead of3..3 and hashes unrelated source. Expected immutable physical span origin and typed/unresolved invalid bounds. Standalone parser repro /private/tmp/breakage-line-position-repro.go and .log, review original retained /private/tmp/corvint-wow-manager/independent-reviews.json. Exact internal regression red/green pending native repair lease V1-0503. No installed rc.1 defect claim.

completion.reason: Already delivered on main by 29902ae5 and 9e44e5fd: breakage-map anchors use physical positions and ignore //line directives; bounds are validated before slicing, invalid anchors become unknown/unresolved instead of panicking, and invalid manifest spans are refused. Re-verified 2026-10-08 at main ecfff8e0: ./internal/breakagemap passes (TestBreakageLineDirectivesPinPhysicalLines, TestBreakageAnchorRejectsInvalidPhysicalSpans and related). Fresh independent Codex review (gpt-6-astra, read-only) of both commits on ecfff8e0: no P0-P2 findings; its sandbox could not execute tests, so execution evidence is the local run above. NOT_OBSERVED: exact release-candidate evidence. Evidence digests are sha256 of the cited files at ecfff8e0. Manual completion because the repair predates this re-verification; no new CEM since no source changed.

title: Breakage map: Go line directives corrupt physical anchors and can panic
